messages:
jordan: Alert from SRE dashboard — eu-west1 embeddings 5xx spike starting ~14:22 UTC. Saw a correlation with the recent quant-path change. Can we fast-track a hotfix? @priya @alex_k
ops-bot: 🚨 metrics: embeddings-service (eu-west1) 5xx rate 4.2% over 5m, p95 latency +30ms, origin tag=canary?false
priya: I'm on call. Do we have a specific patch branch? impact on customer traffic?
alex_k: branch is fix/quant-eu-loader — adds a guard for empty KV-chunks + safer deserialiser. Staged smoke passed (create embed, upsert, small load). No perf regressions in perf tests.
jordan: product is seeing errors for live customers (support flagged two enterprise jobs). I'd like to run a small canary then expand. Requesting expedited approval to bypass the normal 30m scheduling window.
sam: oncall approving expedited canary. Condition: rollback if 5xx >1% sustained over any 10m window or error growth >2x baseline. :thumbsup:
priya: approve from release side too. Also add a temporary route pin for eu traffic until we confirm. Who will run the deploy?
alex_k: I will. Plan: /deploy hotfix fix/quant-eu-loader --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=10m --pin-route=eu-only. I'll create short release note after deploy.
deploy-bot: command received: /deploy hotfix fix/quant-eu-loader --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=10m --pin-route=eu-only
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout to 5% of instances in eu-west1 — expected canary window 10m. Notifying oncall and release channels.
ops-bot: Perf check started — sampling logs and latencies.
jordan: keep logs up. If any spike, manual rollback. Also cc @support for customer comms if we need to escalate.
(7m later)
ops-bot: Canary progress: 5xx rate on canary instances 0.3% (baseline 0.2%). No obvious TLS/timeout anomalies. Trace sample shows the new guard taking effect.
sam: good. expand to 25% canary and monitor another 10m.
alex_k: expanding: /deploy scale hotfix fix/quant-eu-loader --to=25% --monitor=10m
deploy-bot: scaling canary to 25% in eu-west1.
ops-bot: 3m into 25% window: 5xx 0.35%, tokenization latencies stable. No CPU or mem anomalies.
jordan: closing the expedited approval thread — contributors: alex_k + priya + sam. Once expanded to 100% and pinned, please post final release note with commit hash and rollback criteria.
alex_k: Will do. If all good after 10m, I'll flip route pin and submit release note: "hotfix: quant loader guard — prod eu fix, rollforward ok" and include revert steps and canary metrics.
(12m later)
deploy-bot: canary complete — promoting to 100% in eu-west1
deploy-bot: promotion complete. route pin applied: eu-only -> fix/quant-eu-loader (temp pin)
ops-bot: Post-deploy checks (5m): 5xx down to 0.12%, p95 latency back to baseline. No regressions detected.
sam: marking rollback window closed for expedited action. Good job.
jordan: thanks all. Alex — add the brief release note and file the postmortem if customers request more detail.
alex_k: posting release note now and will add the commit + quick test matrix.
